theorems.name: Submission.exists_urysohn_integral_sandwich
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (K O : Set (Euclidean N)), IsCompact K → IsOpen O → K ⊆ O → ∃ g : Euclidean N → ℝ, Continuous g ∧ HasCompactSupport g ∧ tsupport g ⊆ O ∧ ∀ ν : Measure (Euclidean N), (∀ L : Set (Euclidean N), IsCompact L → L ⊆ O → ν L ≠ ∞) → ν K ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (∫ x, g x ∂ν) ∧ ENNReal.ofReal (∫ x, g x ∂ν) ≤ ν O
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
